🌭 Congratulations! You've been hired! 🌭
Welcome on your first night shift job at your New York City HOT DOG cart!

🔥The Job Is Simple:
 • Keep the grill hot
 • Serve hot dogs to the customers
 • Survive in the city that never sleeps! NYC!

Oh.. And one more thing... 😨

📜 Take A Look At The "Rules" If You Want To Make It Through Your First Night Shift..

❌ Every Mistake Will Force The Inspector To Punish You...

🤔 Do You Have What It Takes To Make It In The Big Apple?

 • This game supports multiplayer AND solo!

💰Check out the items inside the shop to troll your friends
